name: GitHub Repository Analysis - Backend Developer
description: Global parsing rules for backend repositories across languages (Go, Java, Python, Node.js, C#, Rust, Ruby). NOTE: Specific evidence mappings (regex patterns and maps_to composite keys) are stored within individual skill files under evidence.github, NOT here. The validate_composite_keys.py script scans both locations to verify coverage.

target_files.notes: Primary source for backing services (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Elasticsearch)
Database schema definitions, migration files, and ORM setups
API contracts, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, Protocol Buffers, and GraphQL schemas
Unit, integration, contract, load, and chaos testing scripts
Core backend source code analyzed for architecture patterns, authentication, concurrency, and telemetry

tasks: Map detected signals to composite keys ({skill_id}.{subskill_id}) using patterns defined in backend skill files
Inspect database models for relational constraints, foreign keys, and indexes vs raw SQL queries
Check resilience patterns — presence of circuit breakers, retry with backoff, and connection pooling configurations
Evaluate observability depth — structured JSON logging with correlation IDs vs simple stdout print statements
